title: STAR ZAPPER
oneLiner: Zap mischievous space bugs before they swarm your tiny star station.
mechanics: Move the starship left and right along the bottom.
Press A to fire bright bolts at descending alien bugs.
Aliens and falling sparks hurt; clear waves to score.
The swarm speeds up and formations tighten over time.
lose: Lose when the starship is hit three times or aliens reach the station.
scoring: Earn points for zapping alien bugs, with bonus points for clearing a wave.
